structure.unit: Titling and Registration of Motor Vehicles

law.catch_line: Transfer and application for certificate of title forwarded to Department
law.text: The transferee shall write his name and address in ink on the certificate of title and, except as provided in §§ 46.2-619 and 46.2-631, shall within thirty days forward the certificate to the Department with an application for the registration of the motor vehicle, trailer, or semitrailer and for a certificate of title.
